final: SELECT status, AVG(event_remaining) AS average_remaining, AVG(event_overspend_rate) AS average_overspend_rate, AVG(event_remaining) / (SELECT AVG(status_remaining) FROM (SELECT status, AVG(event_remaining) AS status_remaining FROM (SELECT e2.event_id, e2.status, AVG(b2.remaining) AS event_remaining FROM event e2 JOIN budget b2 ON b2.link_to_event = e2.event_id GROUP BY e2.event_id, e2.status) GROUP BY status)) AS average_remaining_divided_by_simple_mean FROM (SELECT e1.event_id, e1.status, AVG(b1.remaining) AS event_remaining, AVG((b1.spent - b1.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b1.amount, 0)) AS event_overspend_rate FROM event e1 JOIN budget b1 ON b1.link_to_event = e1.event_id GROUP BY e1.event_id, e1.status) AS event_stats GROUP BY status
